model.license: Apache-2.0 per model card; verify source checkpoint before adoption

preprocess: RTDetrImageProcessor from pinned model card: RGB full-image resize 384x384 bilinear, rescale 1/255, no normalize/pad
postprocess: Official sigmoid top300 query-class pairs; keep highest class per query to avoid contradictory labels; sparse COCO IDs; no NMS; mapped Visiora classes only; global cap30 before scoring
selection: Per target class on development only: among thresholds with at least five accepted predictions and precision >= 90%, choose maximum recall, then precision, then lower threshold; otherwise report no eligible threshold. Freeze before confirmation.
baseline: Same existing YOLOX Nano 0.50 outputs and matching rules; report person/chair/bed TP/FP/FN, precision, recall
gate: Do not replace product unless selected policy improves coverage without materially increasing false references for person/chair/bed on confirmation, and browser timing and license pass separately.
limits: COCO val2017 is known model validation data, not independent Brazilian webcam quality or temporal speech evaluation; no user images or paid calls.
